name: Apex Trader Funding
status_note: Apex's site did not show its current 50K evaluation prices when we checked, so we do not list a price. The rules below come from Apex's own help center.

programs.name: EOD Trailing Drawdown Evaluation -> EOD Performance Account (PA)
programs.drawdown_type: EOD trailing (calculated at market close, enforced intraday the next session). In the PA the threshold stops trailing at $50,100 (starting balance + $100), reached when the highest EOD balance hits $52,100.
programs.consistency_rule: None in evaluation; in the PA, no single profitable day may be 50% or more of total profit since the last approved payout
programs.profit_split: 100% of approved payouts (sim PA); 90/10 in Apex live accounts
programs.payout_frequency: After 5 qualifying trading days (each with at least $250 profit on 50K EOD) since the last payout; days need not be consecutive
programs.payout_rules_note: 50K EOD PA: minimum payout $500; balance must be at least $52,600 to request; Safety Net $52,100 must be maintained for the life of the PA. Max per request by payout number: $1,500 / $1,500 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $2,500 / $3,000. Maximum 6 payouts per PA, after which the PA is closed. PA contract limit is 4 (scaling tiers 2 -> 3 -> 4 contracts) with a tier-based DLL of $1,000 to $3,000. Inactivity: PA closed if fewer than 2 days of $50+ net profit in any rolling 30-day period. Up to 20 active PAs.
programs.notes: Evaluation: 30 calendar days of access, no extensions, no reset fees (a failed evaluation requires a new purchase). Evaluation DLL ($1,000) pauses trading for the session but does not fail the account. No minimum trading days; can pass in one day. 7 calendar days after passing to pay the PA activation fee. Apex's help center says a 'No Activation Fee' purchase option exists but does not publish its price. Per 'EOD Drawdown Explained', Rithmic and WealthCharts evaluation thresholds stop trailing at the target-profit balance, while Tradovate evaluation thresholds trail indefinitely.

programs.name: Intraday Trailing Drawdown Evaluation -> Intraday Performance Account (PA)
programs.drawdown_type: Intraday trailing (follows highest balance including unrealized gains, enforced in real time). In the PA, trailing stops once the threshold reaches starting balance + $100.
programs.consistency_rule: None in evaluation; in the PA, no single profitable day may be 50% or more of total profit since the last approved payout
programs.profit_split: 100% of approved payouts (sim PA); 90/10 in Apex live accounts
programs.payout_frequency: After 5 qualifying trading days (each with at least $200 profit on 50K Intraday) since the last payout
programs.payout_rules_note: 50K Intraday PA: minimum payout $500; balance must be at least $52,600 to request; Safety Net $52,100. Max per request by payout number: $1,500 / $2,000 / $2,500 / $2,500 / $3,000 / $3,000. Maximum 6 payouts per PA, after which the PA is closed. PA contract limit 4 with tier-based scaling and tier-based DLL. Same inactivity rule and 20-PA cap as EOD.
programs.notes: No daily loss limit during the evaluation. 30 calendar days of access, no extensions, no reset fees.

programs.name: Legacy Evaluation (limited-time relaunch)
programs.drawdown_type: Trailing threshold (the Legacy Products page does not say intraday or EOD)
programs.consistency_rule: Apex's own March 17, 2026 news post says Legacy accounts keep a 30% consistency rule (not stated in its help center)
programs.payout_frequency: Apex's own news post describes an 8-day payout cycle with a $50 profit floor for Legacy accounts (not stated in its help center)
programs.notes: Listed on apextraderfunding.com/legacy-products as 'Available Now - Limited Time', $197/month for 50K before discount, same price on Tradovate, WealthCharts and Rithmic; sizes 25K-300K; no daily drawdown, no scaling. The inactivity policy applies to Legacy accounts purchased after March 1, 2026.

news_trading: Allowed, with restrictions: trading during news is allowed as part of a normal strategy; placing orders on both sides to gamble on the outcome or 'chasing the market' is prohibited
ea_bots_allowed: Not allowed: Prohibited Activities states automation and algorithm usage is not allowed; high-frequency trading is prohibited
copy_trading: Restricted: trade copying with other traders is prohibited; the WealthCharts platform page promotes a built-in trade copier for executing trades across multiple accounts
overnight_weekend_holding: Not allowed: positions must be closed before market close. Apex's own March 19, 2026 news post says holding past 4:59 PM ET leads to liquidation.
restricted_countries_note: About 90 countries are restricted, including Serbia, Turkey, Ukraine, Russia, China, Nigeria, Pakistan, Vietnam, Latvia and Cyprus. The US is not restricted. The full list is in Apex's help center.
path_to_live: Discretionary: Apex may move a trader from the simulated PA to a live account at any time, based on discipline, consistency and risk management (one guideline is three consecutive withdrawals from one PA). Live split is 90/10, live payouts can be requested daily (minimum $500, only from profit above a $3,100 safety net).

current_public_promo.applies_to: Evaluations; shown on Apex's site banner when we checked

affiliate_program.notes: Could not confirm from Apex's own site (the affiliate page did not load and the About page does not mention one).

recent_changes_2026.change: Previous evaluation and PA products became 'Legacy' and closed to new purchases; new EOD and Intraday evaluation products launched as one-time purchases with 30-day access, no reset fees, 50% PA consistency, 6-payout cap per PA, and tier-based PA scaling/DLL.
New EOD 50K accounts require 5 days of at least $250 net profit before a payout request.
Legacy accounts relaunched as a limited-time, monthly-billed offer (page last modified 2026-08-25).

pros: One-time evaluation fee with no recurring subscription and no reset fees on the new products.
100% of approved PA payouts go to the trader.
No consistency rule and no minimum trading days during the evaluation; it can be passed in one day.
Choice of EOD or intraday trailing drawdown at every size.
Firm publishes a 90%-off code (SAVENOW) on its own site.
cons: Each PA is capped at 6 payouts (max $1,500-$3,000 per request on 50K), after which it closes and a new evaluation is needed.
Evaluation access expires after 30 calendar days with no extensions.
List prices for the new evaluations and PA activation fees are not published in the help center; they show only in the site's product selector/checkout.
Restricted-country list is long (about 90 countries, including Serbia and Turkey).
best_for: Discretionary futures day traders who want a one-time-fee evaluation with no evaluation consistency rule and accept a 6-payout cap per funded account.
